# E0242: a published schema was deleted

Once a lineage is published, its schemas are fixed: a new revision of the
lineage may only add versions. This revision has fewer schemas than the
published one, so a schema was deleted.

## Example

`old.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				a: string
			}
		}
		"1": {
			schema: {
				a: string
				b?: int
			}
		}
	}
}
lenses: {
	"0.1->0.0": {
		input: _
		result: {
			a: input.a
		}
	}
}
```

`new.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				a: string
			}
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0242]: the new lineage has 1 schemas where the published one has 2
  |
  = help: a published schema is never deleted; add versions, do not remove them
```
